gloss: to look down on; to make light of

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {軽|かろ}んじていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to look down on; to make light of; to belittle
definitions.explanation: To treat something or someone as unimportant or insignificant. Often used in formal or written contexts to describe disrespect or undervaluation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽|かろ}んじて⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not make light of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽|かろ}んじる⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: An attitude that belittles tradition is problematic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽|かろ}んじる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you belittle other people's opinions, you'll end up losing their trust.

notes:
USAGE:
{軽|かろ}んじる is a literary and formal verb. In everyday speech, ⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ or ⟦ばかにする→バカにする：09420_bakanisuru⟧ are more common. It appears frequently in written commentary, editorials, and formal discourse.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Kami-ichidan (ru-verb). Transitive. The older form {軽|かろ}んずる also exists but is archaic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽|かろ}んじる (to make light of life)
- ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽|かろ}んじる (to disregard human rights)
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽|かろ}んじる (to belittle tradition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{侮|あなど}る→侮る：10884_anadoru⟧: to look down on, to scorn
- ⟦{見下|みくだ}す→見下す：09911_mikudasu⟧: to look down on (more colloquial)
- ⟦{蔑|さげす}む→蔑む：10024_sagesumu⟧: to despise, to hold in contempt
